description: Two dancers join one hand, forearms up, and walk round each other.

walkthrough.line: Join {hand} hands with {who}, forearms up, and walk round each other, {amount}.
walkthrough.teach: Join {hand} hands with {who} — forearms up, palms together, elbows bent — and walk forward round each other, keeping the joined hands over the one spot between you, {amount}. Look at each other the whole way, and let the free hand hang at your side.

walkthrough.line: Robins only. Join {hand} hands in the middle and walk round each other, {amount}.
walkthrough.teach: Robins only. Join {hand} hands in the middle — forearms up, palms together, elbows bent — and walk forward round each other, {amount}, keeping the joined hands over the one spot between you. Look at each other the whole way. The larks stand on their places and wait for you.

walkthrough.line: Larks only. Join {hand} hands in the middle and walk round each other, {amount}.
walkthrough.teach: Larks only. Join {hand} hands in the middle — forearms up, palms together, elbows bent — and walk forward round each other, {amount}, keeping the joined hands over the one spot between you. Look at each other the whole way. The robins stand on their places and wait for you.
